channel.title: Dialbubble guides
channel.description: Twilio guides in plain English, from Dialbubble.

item.title: How to get a Twilio Account SID and Auth Token
item.description: Where your Twilio Account SID and Auth Token live in the Console, what each one looks like, how to rotate a token, and how to keep both safe.

item.title: Twilio Auth Token vs API Key: which to use
item.description: Auth Tokens and API Keys both sign in to Twilio, but they carry different risks. Compare them side by side and learn when to pick each of them.

item.title: Can I use Twilio for free? Trial limits
item.description: Twilio's trial is free for 30 days, with 100 SMS and 75 voice minutes. See what's blocked, why custom texts fail, and what upgrading will cost.

item.title: How does Twilio pricing work? A plain guide
item.description: Twilio bills per minute, per text segment and per number, with no plan. See how carrier fees and call legs add up, with a worked monthly bill.

item.title: How much does a Twilio phone number cost?
item.description: US Twilio numbers cost $1.15 a month for local and $2.15 for toll-free, as of November 2026. See the other charges to budget for before you buy.

item.title: How to use a Twilio phone number
item.description: A Twilio number doesn't ring like a SIM. Learn how to make calls, send texts and handle incoming traffic from it, with or without writing code.

item.title: How to make calls from a different number
item.description: You can legally call from a second number you own or have verified. Here are the real options, what they cost, and why spoofing isn't one of them.

item.title: What is outbound caller ID? A plain answer
item.description: Outbound caller ID is the number people see when you call them. Learn how it's set, what Twilio allows, and why your calls can show as spam.

item.title: How to add a verified caller ID in Twilio
item.description: Verify a phone you own so Twilio can show it as your caller ID. Follow the steps, fix verification calls that fail, and learn what it can't do.

item.title: How does Twilio SMS work? Step by step
item.description: Follow one text from API request to handset: queue, carrier, delivery status and replies. Includes a working example and what each status means.

item.title: A2P 10DLC registration: cost and steps
item.description: Which A2P 10DLC brand fits you, what each fee costs as of November 2026, how to get a campaign approved, and how to avoid common rejections.

item.title: E.164 format for US and international numbers
item.description: E.164 is + then country code then number, with no spaces. See US and international examples, conversion rules and the mistakes that cause errors.

item.title: GSM-7 vs UCS-2: SMS encoding and segments
item.description: One emoji can cut a text's segment from 160 characters to 70 and raise its cost. See how GSM-7 and UCS-2 differ, with worked segment counts.

item.title: TwiML examples you can copy and use
item.description: Working TwiML for voice messages, audio, forwarding, menus, voicemail and auto-replies, with what each verb does and the errors to watch out for.

item.title: Twilio call forwarding: how to set it up
item.description: Forward a Twilio number to any phone in a few minutes with a TwiML Bin. Covers caller ID, cost per forwarded call, and the fixes when it fails.

item.title: Twilio call recording: setup, cost and consent
item.description: Turn on Twilio call recording with the API or TwiML, work out the per-minute and storage cost, and learn when you need the other person's consent.

item.title: How to schedule SMS with Twilio
item.description: Twilio can hold a text and send it 15 minutes to 35 days later, using a Messaging Service. See the exact request, how to cancel, and common errors.

item.title: How to send SMS from iPhone with Twilio
item.description: Three ways to send a text from your Twilio number on an iPhone: an app, a Shortcut or the Console. Compare them and see what each one needs first.

item.title: Second phone number for business on iPhone
item.description: Compare the real ways to add a business number to your iPhone: eSIM, hosted phone apps, or your own Twilio account, with honest costs and limits.

item.title: International calls on iPhone from your number
item.description: How to call abroad from an iPhone using a number you own: compare carrier plans, apps and Twilio, turn on Geo Permissions, and estimate the cost.

item.title: Twilio regulatory bundles: get one approved
item.description: Many countries need ID and address proof before Twilio will give you a number. Learn what a regulatory bundle holds and how to get it approved.

item.title: Twilio error 30007: how to fix message filtered
item.description: Error 30007 means Twilio or a carrier filtered your text. Work through the checks in order, rewrite a blocked message and get your delivery back.

item.title: Twilio error 21610: how to fix unsubscribed
item.description: Error 21610 means this person replied STOP to your number. Here's how to confirm it, how they can opt back in, and how to stop paying failed fees.
